mods.name: FlowInventory
mods.description: Smart inventory sorting and activity-based hotbar for Fabric 1.20.1. Sort with R (smart/alphabetical/tier), cycle profiles with G/V, optional auto-detect. Singleplayer and dedicated server (install on server + clients). Bundles Cloth Config for Mod Menu; requires Fabric API.
